purpose: Exercise image-only page ingestion, OCR-derived retrieval, page-only citation, and original-page preview without adding a development fixture or question to the running user library.

input.source_document: 04‑中文‑大语言模型智能体出行日志.pdf
input.generation_method: Rasterized original PDF page at 2.4x and embedded it as the only image in a new one-page PDF; verified the resulting PDF text layer is empty.

run_cap.price_rates_source: Configured SiliconFlow model rates checked 2026-09-29; per-account settlement is not exposed in inference responses. Actual provider usage and configured-rate estimate will be recorded after the run.

expected_question: 图1下方的中文图注写了什么？

actuals.answer: 根据检索到的证据，图1下方的中文图注是“图 1 MobiA 出行日志生成流程图”。

citation.reason: 扫描页识别内容仅用于定位，请核对原始 PDF 页面。

actuals.result: The OCR-derived unit was retrieved; the answer cited physical page 1 with no verbatim quote; the page-preview endpoint returned the original PDF page as a valid PNG. All data was isolated from the running user library and the temporary database was dropped after evidence collection.

limitations: This is a controlled raster-only transformation of a genuine sample-paper page, not a physical camera scan.
A successful run validates the OCR/evidence/citation/page-preview software path for one page; it does not establish general scan OCR accuracy.
The upload response initially reports queued; a successful page-preview response requires the active version to be ready.
